activity_tracking.management_events.description: This field only applies if `activity_tracker_crn` is not populated. If set to `true`, all bucket management events will be sent to Activity Tracker Event Routing.

activity_tracking.read_data_events.description: If set to `true`, all object read events (i.e. downloads) will be sent to Activity Tracker Event Routing.

activity_tracking.write_data_events.description: If set to `true`, all object write events (i.e. uploads) will be sent to Activity Tracker Event Routing.

allowed_ip.description: Individual IP address or range of IP addresses. The entire array will be overwritten in a `PATCH` operation.

metrics_monitoring.metrics_monitoring_cr.description: When the `metrics_monitoring_crn` is not populated, then enabled metrics are sent to the monitoring instance associated to the container's location unless otherwise specified in the Metrics Router service configuration. If `metrics_monitoring_crn` is populated, then enabled events are sent to the Metrics Monitoring instance specified.

metrics_monitoring.request_metrics_enabl.description: If set to `true`, all request metrics (i.e. `rest.object.head`) will be sent to the monitoring service.

metrics_monitoring.usage_metrics_enabled.description: If set to `true`, all usage metrics (i.e. `bytes_used`) will be sent to the monitoring service.
